method_notes: Islington Community School Determined Admission Arrangements 2026-27 (Admission Criteria to Islington Community Primary Schools, criterion 4 Distance): nearness is determined by a computerised mapping system using a straight-line distance measurement from the home address (as defined by the Land & Property Gazetteer) to the midpoint of the school grounds (as determined by Islington LA). Distance is the tiebreaker within criteria 1-3 (looked-after, sibling, exceptional social/medical/SEN); equal distances for a last place are settled by computerised random allocation. City of London Primary Academy Islington uses the same LA measure (centroid of block for flats with a communal entrance). St Mary's Islington CE measures in a straight line to its main gates in Fowler Road. The council's cut-off page says that for VA faith schools the cut-off applies only to applicants considered on home-to-school distance alone, after faith/church criteria.

gaps: Figures come only from the council's three-year cut-off page (no booklet: the 2025-26 primary booklet PDF now returns 'page not found'). Year labels are school years of entry ('2026-27' = April 2026 offer day), assumed to be national-offer-day positions; the page does not say whether they are offer-day or end-of-process figures. 'Not applicable' is not defined on the page: for community schools it is recorded as all_offered (cut-offs are said to apply only to oversubscribed schools); for VA faith schools, academies and free schools it is recorded as not_published because it could mean undersubscribed, no distance-based offers, or figures not supplied (e.g. Whitehall Park free school shows 'Not applicable' in all three years). Many Islington schools are undersubscribed (falling rolls), which fits the many 'Not applicable' entries. The page gives no criterion for the last offer and no applications/offers counts. Figures for VA faith schools are cut-offs for distance-only applicants and do not apply to faith-criteria applicants. Measuring methods of the other VA, academy and free schools (Hungerford, Pooles Park, William Tyndale, St Mary Magdalene, Whitehall Park, Catholic and CE VA schools) not checked: method 'unknown'. PANs from the 2026-27 determined arrangements list. Postcodes from GIAS (Oct 2026). Closed schools (Highbury Quadrant, St Jude and St Paul's - closed Aug 2025; The New North Academy - closed Aug 2026) are not on the cut-off page and are excluded. 'Hugh Myddlelton' typo on the council page corrected to Myddelton.
